title: Writing your own campaign (a tutorial in code)
description: Not a story but a lesson: open tools/CampaignTool/src/writing-campaigns.camp and read it while you play. Each lesson in the file speaks up in your journal as it happens, and in the summer of 1812 the lessons end in a fight at York Factory, its men moved by the script.
note: The tutorial for campaign writers. Read the .camp, not this JSON.

happens.text: [Lesson 2] This line was written by the beat FirstBeat in writing-campaigns.camp. Read Lesson 3 next.
[Lesson 3] Chained waited for FirstBeat, then one day more. Lesson 4 is about dates.

beats.title: Lesson 4: a beat on its day

happens.text: [Lesson 4] It is the 15th of September 1811, the date OnItsDay was given. Lesson 5 raises a flag.
[Lesson 5] FlagReader waited for the flag tutorial_flag_raised. Lesson 6 waits for the cold.

beats.title: Lesson 6: a beat that waits for the cold

happens.text: [Lesson 6] The cold has come, so FirstFrost's AwakenWhen held. Lesson 7 is the whole life of a beat.

beats.title: Lesson 7: the life of a beat
beats.rumour: [Lesson 7] TheWholeLife is awake: it is waiting for a midwinter month.

on_awaken.text: [Lesson 7] TheWholeLife woke: it is November. Look in your journal for its rumour while it waits.

happens.text: [Lesson 7] It is midwinter, so ActivateWhen held and OnActivate ran.

on_resolve.text: [Lesson 7] The tension passed 60 first, so ResolveWhen ended the beat without OnActivate.

on_cancel.text: [Lesson 7] The companies were made one first, so the beat was cancelled.

happens.text: [Lesson 8] CountTheWinters has counted {var:winters} winter(s) in the variable winters.
[Lesson 9] This line came from the function lesson(), written out in TwoTimes when the script was compiled.
[Lesson 10] Spring of 1812. This beat is one of three written by a foreach loop; its id is lesson-spring-1812.
[Lesson 10] Spring of 1813. This beat is one of three written by a foreach loop; its id is lesson-spring-1813.
[Lesson 10] Spring of 1814. This beat is one of three written by a foreach loop; its id is lesson-spring-1814.

do.text: [Lesson 11] random() picked the first of three options.
[Lesson 11] random() picked the second of three options.
[Lesson 11] random() picked the third option (it had twice the weight).

then.text: [Lesson 11] And this line was set with after(days(2), ...) two days ago.

happens.text: [Lesson 12] A headline, made by shout().
[Lesson 12] player.give() has put two twists of tobacco in your pack.

then.text: [Lesson 12] You are a Company man, so this branch of the if ran.
[Lesson 12] You are a Nor'Wester, so this branch of the if ran.

else.text: [Lesson 12] You belong to neither company, so the else ran.

happens.subject: a letter from Lesson 12
happens.text: This letter was sent by news() in the beat SpeakAndDo and took ten days to reach the Factor at York Factory.
[Lesson 13] The York boats are on the river, and the beat Brigades has held them up two days with delay(2).

on_cancel.text: [Lesson 13] The York boats never got out in 1812, so Brigades was cancelled by its CancelWhen.

beats.title: Lesson 15: the quarrel at York
beats.rumour: [Lesson 15] There is bad blood between the Factory and the Nor'Westers' house, and it is getting worse.

do.text: [Lesson 15] A Nor'Westers' canoe has gone from the Factory's landing, and they say the Company's men took it. (Grievance {var:grievances} of 3.)
[Lesson 15] The Factory's hunters were met on the river with Nor'Wester rum and brought their furs to the other house. (Grievance {var:grievances} of 3.)
[Lesson 15] Words, then fists, between the two houses' men at the landing. (Grievance {var:grievances} of 3.)

beats.title: Lesson 16: both houses call out their men

happens.text: [Lesson 16] Both houses have called their men from their work: world.muster() in the beat CallingOut.

on_cancel.text: [Lesson 16] The Nor'Westers never had three men to spare, so CallingOut was cancelled and there will be no fight.

beats.title: Lesson 17: the Nor'Westers march on the Factory

happens.text: [Lesson 17] world.march() has sent the Nor'Westers' men down to the Factory's landing. Watch the river.

beats.title: Lesson 17: the Nor'Westers are at the landing
when: flag:march:Nor'Westers' house (York):the landing at York Factory

happens.text: [Lesson 17] The Nor'Westers are drawn up in ranks at the Factory's landing: world.arrived() is true, so AtTheLanding happened.

beats.title: Lesson 19: the Nor'Westers come on
beats.rumour: [Lesson 19] The Nor'Westers stand at the Factory's landing. Unless someone talks them round, they will come on.

happens.why: for the canoe, the hunters and the insults

happens.text: [Lesson 19] The Nor'Westers are coming on: world.attack() in the beat TheStandoff.

on_resolve.why: the stand-off at York ended without a shot

on_resolve.text: [Lesson 19] You talked the partner round. TheStandoff's ResolveWhen held, so OnResolve ran instead of OnActivate, and world.standDown() sent both houses' men back to their work.

then.why: the Factory beaten by the Nor'Westers

then.text: [Lesson 20] The Nor'Westers carried the day and took ten bales from the Factory's store: world.attackWon() was true.

then.why: the Nor'Westers beaten off at York

then.text: [Lesson 20] The Factory's men beat the Nor'Westers off: world.attackLost() was true.

else.text: [Lesson 20] The Nor'Westers never came up with the Factory, and turned back to their house.

happens.subject: the fight at York
happens.text: There has been fighting between our men and the Canadians at the Factory's landing. Keep your people close to the house.

beats.title: Lesson 21: the end of the lessons

happens.text: [Lesson 21] The lessons are over. Now copy my-campaign.camp, change the header, and write your own.

then.text: [Lesson 21] You told your master you write history: the historical campaign is a good one to read next.
[Lesson 21] You told your master you write stories: company-servant.camp is a good one to read next.

on_complete.text: [Lesson 14] ReadAlong is done: both its steps were.

objectives.text: Wait for the beat FirstBeat (Lesson 2) to happen
Let two days pass while you read Lessons 3 to 6

quests.title: A step the game counts
quests.summary: A hunt step counts what you kill.

on_complete.text: [Lesson 14] OnComplete gave you powder and ball for the hunt.

objectives.text: Kill one beast of any kind (a hunt step with no species)

quests.title: A conversation with choices
quests.summary: A talk step with two choices, each setting a flag.

objectives.text: Ask the Factor what he makes of all this writing

dialogue.text: "Writing, {player}? Every clerk here writes. What sort of writing?"

choices.label: "The history of the country, sir."
choices.reply: "Then mind you write it as it was."

choices.label: "Stories, sir."
choices.reply: "Stories. Well. Not in the Company's ink."

quests.title: A conversation with choices
quests.summary: A talk step with two choices, each setting a flag.

objectives.text: Ask the partner what he makes of all this writing

dialogue.text: "Writing, {player}? The partners at Fort William read nothing but returns."

choices.label: "Stories."
choices.reply: "Then put a good canoe song in them."

quests.title: Homework
quests.summary: Write a campaign of your own.

on_complete.text: [Lesson 14] Homework is done. The last beat, in Lesson 21, waits for it and for the fight at York.

objectives.text: Keep two twists of tobacco in your pack (from Lesson 12)

questlines.title: A fight at York (Lessons 15 to 20)
questlines.summary: From writing-campaigns.camp: men called out, marched, and sent into a fight.

quests.title: Before it comes to blows
quests.summary: The Nor'Westers are drawn up at the Factory's landing. Their partner might still be talked round. (Lesson 18.)

objectives.text: Speak to the Nor'Westers' partner before his men come on

dialogue.text: "Your people have had a canoe of ours, and our hunters' trade, {player}. Somebody will answer for it."

choices.label: "Let me carry your complaint to the Factor myself. Nobody needs to bleed for a canoe."
choices.reply: He looks at his men, and at the Factory's gate. "Very well. But only this once."

choices.label: "Then come on. The Factory is ready for you."
